newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 28.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on July 28. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Nearly one thousand supporters of Megawati Sukarnoputri staged a peaceful commemoration of the police-backed raid on their offices at the former headquarters of the Indonesian Democratic Party on Sunday while Megawati held a commemoration ceremony at her house on Saturday.
The United Development Party (PPP) has nominated its chief, Ismail Hasan Metareum, as the new House of Representatives speaker to challenge Golkar chairman Harmoko.

Police are tightly guarding the Senayan stadium where the final soccer game between Bandung Raya and Persebaya Surabaya will be held on Monday evening. Tens of thousands of supporters have flocked into Jakarta from Surabaya and Bandung to witness the finals.
Police have arrested 55 people during the commemoration of the first anniversary of the July 27 riots on Sunday. They were arrested for not carrying their identity cards and disturbing public order.
